summary.text: Elizabeth Markowitz is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.
She previously ran unsuccessfully for the State Board of Education in 2018 and for Texas House District 28 in a 2020 special election and the 2020 general election.

paragraphs.text: In a 2019 Ballotpedia survey, Elizabeth Markowitz described herself as a native Texan raised in Sugar Land who works as an instructor and textbook author with the Princeton Review.

She said she holds a bachelor's degree in computer science from Trinity University, master's degrees from UT San Antonio and UT Health Science Center Houston, and a doctorate in curriculum and instruction from the University of Houston.
Markowitz won the Democratic primary for Texas State Board of Education District 7 on March 6, 2018, and lost the November 6, 2018 general election to Matt Robinson, 59.5 percent to 40.5 percent.
She lost the January 28, 2020 special runoff for Texas House District 28 to Gary Gates, and lost the November 3, 2020 general election for the same seat to Gates.
In 2022 she finished third among five candidates for Katy Independent School District, Position 1.
In the 2019 survey, Markowitz listed her key messages as high-quality public education for all Texans, affordable healthcare, and a state that fights for its citizens in times of crisis.
